import re

def test_regex_handling():
    tags = "tag1,tag2,tag3"
    tag_list = [tag.strip() for tag in tags.split(',') if tag.strip()]
    regex_pattern = r'(' + '|'.join(re.escape(tag) for tag in tag_list) + ')'
    assert re.match(regex_pattern, "tag1") is not None
    assert re.match(regex_pattern, "tag4") is None

test_regex_handling()
